ideas.title: Uncovering the Web of Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the $11 million Medicaid fraud case, tracing the money and identifying all parties involved.
ideas.angle: Follow the money, identify patterns, and expose the network of individuals and organizations involved
questions: What are the implications for Minnesota's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and bring attention to the need for increased oversight in Minnesota's Medicaid program.
